steps.cmd: RUN sed -i -e 's|https://tritonlang.blob.core.windows.net/llvm-builds|https://oaitriton.blob.core.windows.net/public/llvm-builds|g' setup.py && echo "llvm host references: $(grep -c 'blob.core.windows.net' setup.py || true)"

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=aws,required=false if [ -s /run/secrets/aws ]; then set -a; . /run/secrets/aws; set +a; fi; if [ -z "" ]; then cores=$(nproc); jobs=$(awk -v per="2" '/^MemAvailable:/ {print int($2/1024/1024/per)}' /proc/meminfo); [ -n "${jobs}" ] || jobs=${cores}; [ "${jobs}" -ge 1 ] || j

[builder 9/10] RUN --mount=type=tmpfs,target=/tmp/cupy-wheel set -eu; python -m zipfile -e /wheels/*.whl /tmp/cupy-wheel; count=$(find /tmp/cupy-wheel -name '*.so' | wc -l); echo "shared objects in wheel: ${count}"; [ "${count}" -gt 0 ] || { echo "wheel contains no extensions" >&2; exit 1; }; for so in $(find /tmp/cupy-wheel -name '*.so' | head -20); do /opt/rocm/llvm/bin/llvm-objdump --offloading "${so}" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'gfx[0-9a-z]+' || true; done | sort -u | tee /wheels-arch.txt; echo "arch bundles found: $(wc -l < /wheels-arch.txt)"

[builder 8/10] RUN --mount=type=secret,id=aws,required=false if [ -s /run/secrets/aws ]; then set -a; . /run/secrets/aws; set +a; fi; njobs=""; if [ -z "${njobs}" ]; then cores=$(nproc); njobs=$(awk -v per="2" '/^MemAvailable:/ {print int($2/1024/1024/per)}' /proc/meminfo); [ -n "${njobs}" ] || njobs=${cores}; [ "${njobs}" -ge 1 ] || njobs=1; [ "${njobs}" -le "${cores}" ] || njobs=${cores}; fi; export CUPY_NUM_BUILD_JOBS="${njobs}"; echo "CUPY_NUM_BUILD_JOBS=${njobs}, HCC_AMDGPU_TARGET=gfx950"; CC="sccache gcc" CXX="sccache g++" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python build-wheel.py bdist_wheel --dist-dir=/wheels 2>&1 | tee /wheels-build.log && sccache --show-stats | tee /wheels-cupy-sccache-stats.txt

[builder 7/10] RUN printf '%s\n' 'import multiprocessing, runpy, sys' 'multiprocessing.set_start_method("fork", force=True)' 'sys.argv = ["setup.py"] + sys.argv[1:]' 'runpy.run_path("setup.py", run_name="__main__")' > /opt/cupy/build-wheel.py && cat /opt/cupy/build-wheel.py
[builder 4/10] RUN pip install --no-cache-dir "cython>=0.29.22" "fastrlock>=0.5" numpy setuptools wheel build

[builder 2/10] RUN curl -fsSL "https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/releases/download/v0.19.0/sccache-v0.19.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz" -o /tmp/sccache.tar.gz && tar xzf /tmp/sccache.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin --strip-components=1 "sccache-v0.19.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/sccache" && rm /tmp/sccache.tar.gz && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/sccache && sccache --version
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir build && pip install --no-cache-dir --group dev && pip install --no-cache-dir mkl-static mkl-include

RUN --mount=type=bind,from=torchwheels,source=/wheels,target=/wheels pip install --no-cache-dir /wheels/*.whl && python -c "import torch; print('installed torch', torch.__version__)"

RUN --mount=type=bind,from=tritonwheels,source=/wheels,target=/triton-wheels pip install --no-cache-dir --no-deps /triton-wheels/*.whl && python -c "import triton; print('installed triton', triton.__version__)"
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libpng-dev libjpeg-dev libwebp-dev patchelf && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
